gen-gf-grandstander-gf-armata: Loud and loose-limbed, Grandstander draws every stroke at a constant width, while Armata spaces its letters widely. Pages of text in Armata would read loosely, with generous gaps between letters.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-karla: Grandstander draws every letter with one uninterrupted line width, while Karla packs a tall middle band into sturdy, stocky lowercase. Loud display attitude meets a body that simply gets on with the job.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and sturdy, with a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. And Grandstander, drawn as if with one nib, brings the bold display swagger Khula leaves alone.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-deca: Grandstander is bold and expressive, drawing its display letters in constant-width lines that stay open rather than curling shut. Lexend Deca stays unshaded and approachable, with small-looking capitals beside big lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-michroma: Grandstander bends its bold, expressive strokes like thin plastic tubing, looping freely across the display line. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, with curves leaving daylight.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-text: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters like a bent steel rod, every stroke the same from start to finish. Mozilla Text counters with flared terminals and tall, bold-looking lowercase bodies.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-nata-sans: Grandstander is the loud half, bold and expressive, with lines of constant width and ascenders kept short. Nata Sans steadies it with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans: Expressive Grandstander lays down bold, constant line weight like a flat gray hum. And Noto Sans, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, supplies the quiet counterweight to it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Grandstander is a monoline display face, bold and expressive, running its stroke from start to finish with no modulation. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits beside it with generous space around curve ends.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Bold Grandstander draws stems and connecting strokes with no modulation at all, holding its letters open. And Noto Sans Bengali, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and distinctly open mouths, would read smoothly across paragraphs.
